summary: Mostly not. On BTC, ETH and SOL, price crossing up through the EMA 20 did no better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily, and the golden cross did no better on 1h or 4h. Three results beat random entries and still held without their strongest stretch: price above the SMA 200 on 4h, the death cross short on 1h, and price crossing up through a rising SMA 20 on daily.

verdicts.use: Buying a cross up through the EMA 20
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. Crosses of McGinley, KAMA, ALMA and LSMA at length 20 were also the same as random on 1h and 4h.
Same as random on 1h and 4h. On daily it fired too rarely to judge.
Beat random on 4h at every horizon, and the result held without its strongest stretch. Uptrends carry it. On 1h the result was fragile, and daily had too few moves to judge.

verdicts.use: Shorting the death cross (SMA 50 crosses down SMA 200)
verdicts.text: Beat random on 1h at 20, 50 and 100 candles, but not at 10. On 4h it was the same as random.

verdicts.use: Cross up through a rising SMA 20
verdicts.text: Beat random on daily at 10 and 20 candles, carried by uptrends. The same filter was the same as random on 1h and 4h.

verdicts.use: Holding above McGinley Dynamic or KAMA 20
verdicts.text: Beat random on 4h, but only because of one stretch: it started Dec 24, 2020 for KAMA and Dec 25, 2020 for McGinley. Without it, the same as random.

notes: On 1h, price crossing up through the EMA 20 gave 10,862 entries in 2,779 separate moves. Twenty candles later, these entries were level with random entries. On 4h the cross fires about a quarter as often and was also the same as random. Crosses of the McGinley Dynamic, KAMA, ALMA and LSMA at length 20 were the same as random on 1h and 4h.

Holding while price was above the SMA 200 on 4h beat random entries by 0.69% after 20 candles. That is above a luck band that tops out at 0.43%. The result still beat random without its strongest stretch, between Jan 1, 2021 and May 21, 2021, and it shows at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. Uptrends carry it: there it beat random by 0.50%, while in downtrends it was the same as random. On each coin alone it was fragile, and so was the same condition on 1h.

After the SMA 50 crossed down through the SMA 200 on 1h, a short beat random entries by 0.41% after 20 candles, against a luck band that ends at 0.31%. It shows again at 50 and 100 candles and holds without its strongest signal. At 10 candles it was the same as random. Neither uptrends nor downtrends alone clear their band, at 0.33% and 0.40%, and on 4h the same short was the same as random.

On daily candles, price crossing up through an SMA 20 that had risen 0.5% or more over 10 candles beat random entries by 8% after 20 days. That comes from 107 entries in 65 moves. It holds without its strongest signal and shows at 10 candles, but not at 50 or 100. Uptrends carry it at 10% over random, while downtrends had too few moves to judge. On 1h this filter was the same as random, and on 4h only SOL beat random, by 2.09%. The version that needs a flat SMA 20 was the same as random on 1h and 4h.

Some results rest on one stretch. On 4h, holding above the McGinley Dynamic 20 beat random by 0.37%. The gain comes from the stretch between Dec 25, 2020 and Jun 18, 2021. KAMA 20 beat random by 0.25%, from the stretch between Dec 24, 2020 and Mar 14, 2021. Without those stretches, both were the same as random. On daily, price crossing up through the ALMA 20 did 1.44% worse than random, but only because of signals between Jan 12, 2022 and Aug 7, 2022.

For a long DCA bot on these pairs, a cross up through a length-20 average or the golden cross added nothing. The DCA orders and take profit do the work, so you can leave those crosses out. Price above the SMA 200 on 4h is the result to test as a filter beside your other start conditions, and it showed in uptrends only. On the 1h death cross short, the gap appeared at 20 candles and later, not at 10. A take profit that usually fills within 10 candles would close those deals before that point.
